name: ThumbsUp or Down Reactions
author: ipodguy79

sections.description:
ThumbsUp or Down Reactions (TUOD) is a clean, fast, and fully customizable WordPress plugin that allows visitors to express feedback on your content with a simple thumbs up 👍 or thumbs down 👎.

Packed with options but easy to use, TUOD works on any post type, includes per-IP voting protection, AJAX-based voting (no reloads), and customizable labels, colors, sizes, and optional glowing effects.

🧪 Live Demo: hotspringsofbc.ca

💎 Pro version coming soon: Upload your own icons, advanced styling, per-user voting, analytics, and more!

TUOD is built for creators, bloggers, ecommerce shops, and developers who want simple, stylish user interaction with zero bloat.

Features

  • 👍👎 Thumbs up/down voting on posts, pages, and products
  • 💬 Customizable labels like “Liked this spring” or “Didn’t like this article”
  • 🎨 Choose your own color and vote count text
  • 🔒 One vote per post per visitor (IP-based)
  • 🔁 Users can change their vote at any time
  • ⚡ AJAX-based voting — no page reload
  • 🧮 Total vote tracker shown in admin settings
  • 📱 Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • 🖼️ Icon display and thumb glow effects
  • 🎛️ Lightweight and intuitive admin options
  • 🧰 Cleanly coded and developer-friendly

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip file via the WordPress admin panel (Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Visit Settings → TUOD Reactions to configure your options.
  4. Enable thumbs for posts, pages, or custom post types and you’re ready to go!
sections.faq:
Can users vote more than once?

Each visitor can vote once per post, and they can change their vote at any time. Voting is tracked by IP address.

Will it work with WooCommerce products or custom post types?

Yes! You can enable thumbs for any post type right from the TUOD settings page.

Can I customize the wording, color, and size?

Absolutely — you can change the label above the buttons, the text for each reaction, the color, and the size of both the thumbs and the text.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — coming soon! The Pro version will include:
– Upload custom icons
– Logged-in user vote tracking
– Vote analytics dashboard
– Style per post type
– Shortcode mode
– Developer hooks
